source_evidence: Exact player 'No let’s walk' selects the offered foot expedition, all four party members (V/Cirren/Fenar/Mara). D341~06:30–07:30 Hessa and her husband willingly agree to keep V's intact coach and four healthy horses in their sheltered yard and feed/water/check them with V's own stored feed for up to seven days, no added fee or estate payroll, guardian duties remain unchanged; no permanent custody/ownership transfer. Mara retains her actual documents/copies; portable ancestral coffer/original metal leaves/container left in secured coach in Hessa's agreed safekeeping for the expedition, not transferred as property or cashed; party carries relevant copies/sketch. DM routine provisioning decision: 21 of30 ration-person-days (seven days for three eaters) divided into traveling packs, remaining9 rations and40 feed animal-days stored with coach; no new purchase or expense. Daily D341 ration/feed charge remains pending until day allocation; no consumption posted twice. Remote upland occurrence thresholds40 day/30 exposed night; real visible Python secrets d100=34 triggers day encounter (no night check), type54 dangerous humanoid/organized predator. H hostile if confronted; N independent potentially dangerous. Actual d60=6 row2 range4–6, hobgoblin scouts mapping paths; actual severity75 serious. Fixed composition before any player response: three Hobgoblin Iron Shadows (VGM p162, GitHub 5etools-mirror-3/5etools-src/data/bestiary/bestiary-vgm.json blob096692c78697e6eb42fa2133565afca0a2a40baf full selected record), CR2 each450XP, base1350 x2=2700 adjusted serious near Hard threshold2900, no extra forces. Each HP32 AC15 speed40 STR14 DEX16 CON15 INT14 WIS15 CHA11, Acrobatics+5 Athletics+4 Stealth+5 passive12 darkvision60 Common/Goblin; wizard DC12 attack+4, cantrips minor illusion/prestidigitation/true strike, L1 3 slots charm person/disguise self/expeditious retreat/silent image, no precasts. Multiattack four unarmed/dart attacks +5,1d4+3 B/P, dart20/60; may Shadow Jaunt once before/after attack, magical teleport30ft to visible unoccupied space, BOTH origin and destination dim light/darkness; no sunlight sensitivity or imported deity/lore. Independent motive reconnaissance of usable old upland routes for their own armed band's movement, seek to prevent observed witnesses compromising scouting; not ancestry connection or proven named employer. D341~11:30 after6 terrain miles/4h along first broad track, broken aqueduct arches visible among woodland. Cirren notices three masked red-skinned hobgoblins measuring and sketching the track from about85–105ft, one gestures to other two. Tactical local grid north +y, track15ft wide, party clustered behind bend/outcrop near(0,0), H1(0,85) on track in daylight, H2(20,100) by masonry arch in deep dim shade and half cover, H3(-15,105) by shaded stone/tree cover (half cover), broken slope/brush off track difficult, open retreat south; uphill bypass through rough woods possible but unsurveyed. No active concealment check, no guaranteed surprise, no enemy initiative/attack or V decision; bend and enemy focus means party has observed before obvious contact, NPCs not yet visibly reacting. No additional encounter roll, travel beyond6mi, HP/resources spent or daily supply charge. Pause at first actionable sighting. Actual raw receipts preserved.
